extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional home care and aged care provider. Ask about the care needs, mobility, medical conditions, and any dementia or behavioural support needs. Ask about the home environment, access, and whether the client receives a government package. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after an assessment. Do not provide clinical advice or promise a specific care outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.q: How much does home care cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Home care is priced per hour, and the rate depends on the day and the type of care. Tell us the care needs and hours required.
Yes, we provide help with showering, dressing, grooming, and toileting. We agree on the level of help during the in-home assessment.
Yes, we do cleaning, laundry, and meal preparation. We agree on the tasks together and write them into the care plan.
Yes, we provide companionship and social support, including outings and visits. Tell us what you enjoy when we meet.
Yes, we can prompt and assist with medication as directed by your health provider. Tell us the routine when you book.
Yes, we provide transport to appointments and shopping. Tell us the destinations and times when you book.
Yes, we provide dementia support. Tell us about the person's needs, and we will confirm which carers have the right training.
Yes, we provide overnight and sleepover care. The overnight rate is listed separately in your quote.
Yes, we provide short-term respite for family carers. Tell us how long you need a break for, and we will check availability.
Yes, registered nurse visits are available for clinical care. Tell us what the nurse needs to do so we can quote the right time.
Yes, we provide post-hospital support. Tell us the discharge plan so the carer can follow it.
Carer screening checks are [list screening checks held]. We confirm which checks each carer holds before their first visit.
We can talk to you about Home Care Packages and NDIS funding. Tell us your funding details, and we will confirm what we can provide.
Yes, live-in care is available. Tell us the hours and tasks you need, and we will quote the arrangement.
We match carers to your needs and preferences. We try to keep the same carers where we can, so you have continuity.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee.
Our insurer is [insurer name] and our policy number is [policy number]. We can send certificates before care starts.
24/7 care is available through overnight and live-in arrangements. Tell us the hours you need, and we will confirm availability.
We do a free in-home assessment, then match a carer and create a care plan with you. Call us to book the assessment.
We service [service area] and nearby suburbs. Tell us your suburb when you call, and we will confirm whether we cover it.

kb.q: Can you arrange care at short notice?
kb.a: Sometimes. Tell us when care is needed, and we will check which carers are free and let you know the earliest start.
